about: The AI module's Settings rows, for the UI kit's Settings check (UI kit 0.30.0+, framework F110). None since 0.9.0: its only row, "Bot chatter", went with the archived banter (git tag archive/emotes-0.4.2). The file stays so the UI kit doesn't fall back to its old built-in list for AI copies. Copied into the game with the module — don't edit the game's copy.
